sloka: प्राकृतो ऽन्यः कथं चेमां भूमिमागन्तुमर्हति ।उदधेरप्रमेयस्य पारं वानरपुङ्गव ।। ५.३७.४१।।।।
transliteration: prākṛto 'nyaḥ kathaṁ cemāṁ bhūmimāgantumarhati ।udadheraprameyasya pāraṁ vānarapuṅgava ।। 5.37.41।।।।

translations.english: "O great monkey I have understood your strength and power. Your speed is like the Windgod's and your power is astonishing and splendid.
